analytic.measure_differs: Open CASCADE's pipe takes the lateral area as the circle's perimeter times the length, 2 pi r L, which is the area of a right cylinder; the oblique cylinder's is the perimeter of its section perpendicular to the path, the ellipse of semi-axes r and r cos(t), times L, 4 r E(sin(t)) L with E the complete elliptic integral of the second kind (17.6095465120731258655 L here, mpmath to 20 digits), plus the two tilted discs, pi r^2 each. Open CASCADE's area is 282.743 against 267.863, 5.6% high; its volume, centroid and inertia are the closed forms'. The body is the right cylinder of the disc sheared along z, so every moment is the disc's: with X = x, Y = s cos(t), Z = s sin(t) + z about the centre, over the disc x^2 + s^2 <= r^2 and z in [-L/2, L/2], a density cos(t), the second moments are cos(t) L pi r^4 / 4 for X, cos(t)^3 L pi r^4 / 4 for Y and cos(t) (sin(t)^2 L pi r^4 / 4 + pi r^2 L^3 / 12) for Z, and the only product is YZ = cos(t)^2 sin(t) L pi r^4 / 4
analytic.occt_file_measure_differs: Open CASCADE's own STEP of the pipe carries the oblique cylinder (Arris reads it and measures 267.863225909482, the closed form to 4e-14), but its own area of it is 282.743, the right cylinder's: the fault is in its measurement, not its shape
